name: Soyuz-2
about: Soyuz-2 (1968-093A), a crewed vehicle (7K-OK), launched 1968 Oct 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Oct 27), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
